# Feito
> Concierge for traffic, not navigation. 
Turin tells you WHEN to leave, not HOW to get there. Hyperpersonalized to your routine. Not yet available.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://turinflow.com.br (webpage is work in progress)
- Pricing: https://turinflow.com.br (unavailable)

- Privacy Policy: https://turinflow.com.br (unavailable)

## About
Turin Flow is a Brazilian traffic app for parents (30s-40s, medium-high net worth). 
To be developed, first on iOS. On-device travel time model + traffic incident API. 
Zero maps needed — pairs with Waze or Google Maps.
